entities.summary: Indrani Mukerjea is a British former HR consultant and media executive. She is the ex-wife of Peter Mukerjea, a retired television executive. In 2007, she co-founded INX Media with him, and took on the role of CEO. She resigned from the company in 2009, and later sold her stake in it. In 2015, she was arrested and charged as the main accused in the alleged murder of her daughter, Sheena Bora. After more than six years in custody, she was released on bail in 2022. Starting from 2024, she ventured into theatre production and acting.
